name: arc_jordan_neighborhood
header:
theorem arc_jordan_neighborhood {A U : Set Plane} (hA : IsArc A)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hAU : A ⊆ U) :
    ∃ C : Set Plane, IsJordanCurve C ∧ A ⊆ inside C ∧ C ∪ inside C ⊆ U

name: compact_obstacle_jordan
header:
theorem compact_obstacle_jordan {A L : Set Plane} (hA : IsArc A)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint L A)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : Set Plane, IsJordanCurve C ∧ A ⊆ inside C ∧ L ⊆ outside C ∧
      ∀ x ∈ C, ∃ y ∈ A, Plane.supDist x y < ε
